# StickerAI
> Free AI WhatsApp Sticker Maker Online — no app download, no sign up required

## About
StickerAI (stickersit.com) is a free, browser-based AI sticker maker that generates custom stickers for WhatsApp, Telegram, iMessage, and Discord. Users type a text prompt describing their sticker idea, choose from 8 artistic styles (Cute Kawaii, Chibi, Pixel Art, Cartoon, Hand-drawn, 3D Rendered, Minimalist, Retro/Vintage), and download generated stickers as PNG files. The tool uses AI-powered image generation via Pollinations.ai and requires no sign-up, no app download, and no payment. It works entirely in the web browser on any device.

## Pages
- [AI Sticker Maker — Homepage](https://stickersit.com): Full sticker creation tool with 8 style options, step-by-step tutorial, example stickers, export guides for WhatsApp/Telegram/iMessage/Discord, and FAQ covering how to create stickers, supported platforms, pricing, prompt tips, and usage rights.
- [World Cup 2026 Sticker Maker](https://stickersit.com/world-cup): FIFA World Cup 2026-themed sticker creation tool with sport-specific prompt ideas, team customization guidance, and World Cup FAQ.
- [Terms of Service](https://stickersit.com/terms): Usage terms, AI-generated content policies, and disclaimer.
- [Privacy Policy](https://stickersit.com/privacy): Data collection, cookie usage, and third-party services.

## Styles
Cute Kawaii, Chibi, Pixel Art, Cartoon, Hand-drawn, 3D Rendered, Minimalist, Retro/Vintage

## Platforms
WhatsApp (WebP/PNG), Telegram (PNG via @Stickers bot), iMessage (PNG), Discord (PNG, 320x320)

## Pricing
Free. No sign-up required. No premium tiers. No watermarks. Monetized via Google AdSense.
